corrections.reason: Replace maximum breath-holding with comfortable ordinary breathing observations. Rounded composition explicitly applies to dry air by volume; other gases are not all carbon dioxide. Water vapour varies. Avoid claiming every organism requires oxygen.
Adult assembles secured pin; no running with pin or mouth blowing. Motion transfers energy rather than creating it. Avoid changing national capacity rankings.

Use about 71% surface water. Salinity, accessibility and quality differ. No absolute claim seawater is unusable by all industry or freshwater is drinkable. Keep essential hygiene. Harvested water requires purpose-appropriate care; stepwells have different water sources. Do not imply all receive river seepage.
Distinguish food energy, solar warming, photovoltaic generation and thermal devices. Cloudy conditions are not disappearance of the Sun. Stored energy is finite; availability is conditional.
Do not collect or taste unknown fallen fruit. Forests are interacting systems, not just trees. Matter is recycled; energy flows. Local ecological suitability and long-term plant care matter.

Safe teacher-provided soils; magnifier away from sunlight. Colour alone does not establish fertility. Soil formation varies but useful topsoil is generally not renewable on human timescales. Mineral deposits are distinct from manufactured metals, and not all rocks take millions of years to form.

Observe transport safely and verify fuel rather than guessing. Distinguish LPG/CNG. Fossils formed from ancient organic matter, not necessarily dinosaurs. Natural gas and electric vehicles do not have zero lifecycle impact. No child stove or cylinder handling.

Renewability depends on timescale and conditions, not unlimited access. Local groundwater can be depleted. Metal recycling conserves finite stocks. Clear appearance and fresh smell cannot establish air or water safety.

Question 2 tests pollution rather than suggesting unlimited clean air. Question 3 specifies a petrol-engine scooter. Solar cooker question includes concentrated-light safety. Cloudy-week scenario explicitly asks what additional information is needed. Classification tree states selected examples, so it does not imply fossil fuels exhaust all non-renewable resources.
Preserve all four source projects with adult permissions, privacy, evidence limits and follow-through. Interviews cannot establish illness causation; specimen work must not damage sites.
